analysis: The supplied units are BASE text excerpts (lines 2024-2838) of docs/architecture/inference.md, a documentation-only change. The patch hunks are for other regions: a KV re-slice floor note near line 985, a cluster service heartbeat/health-file paragraph near head line 3532, and cluster runtime text near head line 5234. None of the changed lines fall inside the supplied base excerpts, and no source code is modified. The excerpts describe existing behavior, which this PR does not change: MTP acceptance, sampling defaults, the JSON-constrained Qwen path, tool parsers, MiMo media accounting, and Qwen4 ownership. They touch the T-041 cache identity and security checks only through a statement that sampler state is not part of prefix/SSD cache identity. That statement is unchanged here. No change to provider keys, attestation, coordinator trust boundaries, encryption, or authorization appears in these excerpts, so I found no regression. Remaining integration questions: the new documented per-part health file (`DARKBLOOM_CLUSTER_MEMBER_HEALTH_FILE`, `part-health.json`) and the supervisor liveness guard. Those hunks are outside the supplied units, so the file path permissions, the PID check and any TB-003 local-operator implications could not be examined. The new KV re-slice floor text (head lines 985-989) is also outside these units. If the corresponding code changes sit in other batches, they warrant a check for admission and availability effects (T-029, T-016-type DoS). The patch excerpt was truncated, so I did not treat the unseen hunks as safe.
